metadata.title: Open Market Note #002 — ERCOT Duration Baseline
metadata.description:
13-month empirical baseline for scarcity pricing duration ($100 & $250/MWh) and 8h BESS charging availability in ERCOT (West, North, South, Houston).

Package contains documentation (README.md), parameter ledger (PARAMS.md), reproducible python code, summary results (results.json), figures, data manifest (data_manifest.json).

Source Data Attribution: Grid Status Data (https://www.gridstatus.io/), compiled under manifest-only compliance per Terms of Use section 4.2
